Description: Unique site code (e.g. PB01 = Punjab site 1; SD=Sindh; BL=Balochistan; KP=KPK)
City or district name of the field site (publicly known district centroids)
Pakistani province: Punjab / Sindh / Balochistan / KPK
Growing season identifier (e.g. Kharif_2015 or Rabi_2016)
Season category: kharif (May–Nov) or rabi (Nov–Apr)
Primary crop grown: wheat / rice / cotton / sugarcane / mango
Latitude of district centroid (publicly available administrative data)
Longitude of district centroid (publicly available administrative data)
Normalized Difference Vegetation Index — (B8-B4)/(B8+B4)
Enhanced Vegetation Index — 2.5*(B8-B4)/(B8+6*B4-7.5*B2+1)
Normalized Difference Water Index — (B3-B8)/(B3+B8)

Normalized Difference Red Edge — computed as (B8A-B5)/(B8A+B5) in GEE where B5 (705nm) and B8A (865nm) are native S2 bands. NOTE: The local compute_indices() function previously contained a bug using B4 instead of B5; this has been corrected in feature_engineering.py v1.0.0.
Leaf Area Index — estimated from EVI via LAI = 3.618*EVI - 0.118
Bare Soil Index — ((B11+B4)-(B8+B2))/((B11+B4)+(B8+B2))
Standard deviation of NDVI across all cloud-free images in the season composite — measures temporal crop variability
Minimum seasonal NDVI across composite images
Maximum seasonal NDVI across composite images
Mean seasonal air temperature (season-type imputed from Open-Meteo Pakistani climatology: rabi=19°C ± noise; kharif=30°C ± noise)
Total seasonal rainfall (season-type imputed from CHIRPS climatology: rabi=120mm ± noise; kharif=280mm ± noise)
Estimated volumetric soil moisture (linearly scaled from NDWI; range 16–28%)

Target class: Healthy / Stressed / Diseased. IMPORTANT — label circularity: labels are derived deterministically from the vegetation health composite 0.5·NDVI + 0.3·NDRE + 0.2·EVI via tertile split. Since NDVI, NDRE, and EVI are also model input features, classifiers partly learn the rule that generated their own labels. Reported accuracy is an upper bound for spectral separability under these proxy labels, not independently validated disease detection accuracy.
